generator: Tripo API v3.1 (tripo-cli 0.7), smart_low_poly=true unless noted
conventions: glTF Y-up, metres, base at y=0, centred on XZ, front faces +Z. Untextured files carry a placeholder material 'marble_placeholder' (pale cream, roughness 0.8) meant to be overridden; textured statues carry Tripo PBR (baseColor + metallicRoughness JPEG, normal PNG) at 1024 px.

assets.notes: Normalised to 1 m tall (head and neck, cut at the neck base, no plinth); pale marble PBR texture at 1024 px. Image-to-model from a Tripo concept image after two text-to-model attempts came out with a bare face. The veil wraps the head and lies over the face, but at this polycount the face relief (eye hollows, nose, lips) reads quite strongly: it reads as a weathered veiled head rather than a fully shrouded one.
